## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
`preview` needs fixing before merge because its containment check compares paths without resolving them, so a relative path containing `..` still reads files outside the home directory.

## Changes
This pull request adds `preview` and `settings_file` to `app/paths.py`. It also adds tests for both helpers in `tests/test_paths.py` and a one-line note file at `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — Calling `preview(home, "../secret.txt")` returns the contents of a file outside `home`. `Path.is_relative_to` compares path parts as text without collapsing `..`, so `home/../secret.txt` passes the check. A symlink inside `home` that points outside it also passes. — Any caller that passes a user-chosen relative path can read files outside the selected home directory, up to 200 characters each. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
